title: polystylus cornu-cervi
intro: Polystylus cornu-cervi, commonly known as Deer Horn Polystichum, is a type of fern native to China and other parts of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Deer Horn Polystichum are attributed to its ability to expel phlegm, clear heat, and calm the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
